decisions.objective: Create one evidence-backed portfolio across the game and site.
decisions.hypothesis: A shared control plane will reduce diagnosis time and prevent unsupported promotion claims.
decisions.baseline: Specialist systems were strong but fragmented.
decisions.decision: Adopt the control plane as the canonical cross-surface improvement portfolio.
decisions.nextExperiment: Measure diagnosis time and recommendation completion over the next three material changes.

decisions.objective: Turn ranked quality findings into safe, repeatable repairs.
decisions.hypothesis: Versioned repair recipes can resolve deterministic gaps without inventing evidence or damaging unrelated work.
decisions.baseline: The control plane verified and reported gaps but did not execute repairs.
decisions.decision: Adopt bounded automatic apply as the default improvement command and keep arbitrary code, creative choices, and playtests assisted.
decisions.nextExperiment: Observe the first three automatic evidence repairs and tighten any recipe whose declared outputs drift.
